You fall asleep together under the starry sky and wake up by the rising sun. Or you simply enjoy some us-time on the pearly white beaches of Zanzibar and in its most romantic resorts.
blocks.html: …the two of you tracking lions across the Serengeti or venturing down into the Ngorongoro Crater. Falling asleep side by side beneath a sky full of stars and being woken by the sunrise. Or simply savouring some time for yourselves on the pearl-white beaches of Zanzibar and in its most romantic resorts.

blocks.orig: No matter if you’ve just tied the knot or have been together for ages – chances are your love for (romantic) adventures connects you. Our activities and Tanzania holidays for couples give you just that… and so much more!
blocks.html: Whether you are newlyweds or have been a couple for years, there is a good chance that a shared love of (romantic) adventure is part of what binds you. Our activities and Tanzania holidays for couples deliver precisely that… and plenty more besides.

blocks.orig: In your very own safari jeep and with your personal guide and driver, you’ll discover the country’s most beautiful national parks. Our highly-experienced guides know all the best spots and thanks to their laserbeam eyes, they can even find that one special animal you’ve always wanted to see from kilometres away. Don’t worry about finding the right route (so no fights over that!) and simply focus on each other and the amazing landscape and animals around you.
blocks.html: With a safari jeep all to yourselves and your own guide and driver, you explore the finest national parks in the country. Our highly-experienced guides know every great spot, and their eagle eyes can pick out that one animal you have always longed to see from kilometres away. There is no need to worry about navigating (so no arguments about the route), which leaves you free to concentrate on each other and on the stunning scenery and wildlife all around.

blocks.orig: In this article, we’ve put together the ultimate must-sees and must-dos for your couple holiday or honeymoon in Tanzania, which will elevate your trip to the next romantic level.
blocks.html: For this article we have gathered the essential sights and experiences for a couple's holiday or honeymoon in Tanzania, the kind that will take your trip to a whole new level of romance.

blocks.orig: Flying high over the world-famous Serengeti in a hot air balloon is an experience that you’ll cherish forever. Just after sunrise, when the animals are most active, you fly over the plains with nothing but the sound of the occasional blow into the balloon. Usually, you share the basket with other people, but if you have some money to spare, you can even book it for just the two of you! No matter what this adventure eventually looks like for you, it will certainly lift you up to cloud nine 😉
blocks.html: Drifting high above the world-famous Serengeti in a hot air balloon is a memory you will treasure for the rest of your life. Shortly after sunrise, when wildlife is at its liveliest, you float over the plains with no sound but the occasional burst of the burner. Normally the basket is shared with other passengers, but if your budget stretches that far, you can reserve it for just the two of you. Whatever shape this adventure takes for you, it is sure to carry you up to cloud nine 😉

blocks.orig: Sail towards the sunset on the Indian Ocean! This sunset cruise might just be the perfect opportunity to propose to your loved one or, at the very least, it will create a special memory. With snacks and drinks (or even a delicious dinner) and the sun setting on the horizon, this is the pinnacle of romance!
blocks.html: Set sail into the sunset over the Indian Ocean. A sunset cruise could be the ideal moment to pop the question, and at the very least it will leave you with a special memory. With snacks and drinks (or even a delicious dinner) as the sun slips below the horizon, romance does not get much better than this.

blocks.orig: Night safaris add just that bit of excitement to a safari, as you drive into parks like Arusha National Park or Lake Manyara National Park in the darkness of the night! Luckily, your safari jeep is equipped with a searchlight so that you can spot all the nocturnal animals. And should your loved one get startled by the sound of the animals, just move a little closer to each other and all will be fine.
blocks.html: A night safari adds an extra thrill, taking you into parks such as Arusha National Park or Lake Manyara National Park after dark. Fortunately your safari jeep comes with a searchlight, so you can pick out all the nocturnal creatures. And if the animal noises make your partner jump, simply shuffle a little closer together and everything will be fine.

blocks.orig: Extend your wedding you had at home or renew your vows in a traditional Maasai wedding ceremony in the middle of the savannah! The women of the tribe dress and adorn the bride with traditional clothing and jewellery and take her into a wedding boma. The warriors take the groom to meet the bride, after which an elder blesses you. The entire tribe welcomes you as a married couple – including singing, dancing and eating goat meat, the last step of a Maasai wedding. Get married (again): right here, almost right now!
blocks.html: Carry on the wedding you celebrated at home, or renew your vows, with a traditional Maasai wedding ceremony out on the savannah. The women of the tribe dress the bride in traditional clothing and jewellery and lead her into a wedding boma. The warriors then bring the groom to the bride, after which an elder gives you his blessing. The whole tribe receives you as a married couple, with singing, dancing and a meal of goat meat as the closing part of a Maasai wedding. Tie the knot (again): right here, and almost right now.

blocks.html: Thrilling adventures for couples in Tanzania

blocks.orig: Just the two of you, a couple of donkeys and some Maasai somewhere in the middle of nowhere. The Empakai Crater is a smaller crater in the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, a few hours drive from the famous Ngorongoro Crater. The road stops right at the crater and together you start walking. After two nights under the starry sky, you reach the barren but magical landscape of Lake Natron. Here you’ll have the feeling that you are the only few people left on this earth. Until you reach your lodge, of course, where you can enjoy a well-deserved massage and a delicious dinner.
blocks.html: Only you two, a few donkeys and a handful of Maasai, far from anywhere. The Empakai Crater is a smaller crater within the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, a few hours' drive from the well-known Ngorongoro Crater. The road ends at the crater rim, and from there you set off on foot together. Two nights under the stars later, you arrive at the bare yet magical landscape of Lake Natron, where it feels as though you are the last few people on earth. That is, until you get to your lodge and a well-earned massage and delicious dinner await.

blocks.orig: If you want to dive even deeper into the Tanzanian flora and fauna, join a walking safari. Guided by an armed ranger, you get to meet the country’s famous wildlife up close and see little animals like insects, birds and rodents you’d normally miss in a safari jeep. The excitement of walking in the middle of the savannah or in a jungle full of wild animals will surely strengthen the bond between you.
blocks.html: To get even closer to Tanzania's plants and animals, join a walking safari. With an armed ranger leading the way, you meet the country's famous wildlife at close quarters and notice the small creatures, such as insects, birds and rodents, that you would normally overlook from a safari jeep. The thrill of walking through open savannah or a jungle teeming with wild animals is bound to bring you closer together.

blocks.orig: Okay, climbing the Kilimanjaro might not be private nor romantic. After all, you’ll be joined by guides, porters, and cooks. However, sharing a climb with your partner can definitely strengthen the connection between you. Feeling exhausted, pushing each other to not give up and eventually reaching Uhuru Peak together create the memory of a lifetime. And if you still like each other’s smell after four or five days of not showering, you might just be meant to be together!
blocks.html: Admittedly, climbing Kilimanjaro is neither private nor especially romantic, since guides, porters and cooks come along too. Yet a climb shared with your partner can genuinely deepen your connection. Being worn out, urging each other on and finally standing on Uhuru Peak together makes a memory that lasts a lifetime. And if you still like the way each other smells after four or five days without a shower, you may well be made for each other.

blocks.html: Where to sleep? 4 romantic suggestions for couples in Tanzania

blocks.orig: This beautifully designed lodge is located in the treetops of Lake Manyara, right in the middle of the jungle. Each treehouse welcomes you with a cosy sitting room, a comfy bed, an enormous outside deck, a freestanding tub and a shower surrounded by tree branches. Enjoy complete privacy and spot all the wildlife in the surrounding trees with the lodge’s Swarovski binoculars (not adorned with crystals).
blocks.html: This beautifully designed lodge perches in the treetops of Lake Manyara, deep in the jungle. Every treehouse offers a snug sitting room, a comfortable bed, a huge outdoor deck, a freestanding bath and a shower wrapped in tree branches. You have total privacy, and the lodge's Swarovski binoculars (crystals not included) let you watch the wildlife in the trees around you.

blocks.orig: The Emerson Spice Hotel in Stone Town truly resembles the fairytales of 1001 Arabian Nights. The rooms are decorated in an Arabic style with luxurious fabrics and warm colors, and the sounds of Stone Town floating in through open windows along with the sea breeze. Sleeping here will feel like you have gone back in time. Celebrate your love in the L’amour Toujours suite or indulge in a courtesan’s boudoir called Violetta. Enjoy romantic dinners in the Secret Garden or on the rooftop terrace. Here, one of the city’s best restaurants offers views over the corrugated roofs of Stone Town, with the blue of the Indian Ocean in the distance.
blocks.html: Stone Town's Emerson Spice Hotel feels as if it has stepped out of the tales of 1001 Arabian Nights. Rooms are furnished in Arabic style with sumptuous fabrics and warm colours, while the sounds of Stone Town drift in on the sea breeze through open windows. A night here feels like travelling back through time. Celebrate your love in the L’amour Toujours suite, or treat yourselves to Violetta, a courtesan's boudoir. Romantic dinners can be enjoyed in the Secret Garden or up on the rooftop terrace, where one of the city's finest restaurants looks out over Stone Town's corrugated rooftops to the blue Indian Ocean beyond.

blocks.orig: Mnemba Island is THE romantic getaway. With just a few private bandas on a small island, this place makes you feel like a successful Robinson Crusoe couple – stranded, happy and making it work! From your bed you dive straight into the crystal clear water of the Indian Ocean surrounded by amazing coral reefs. Enjoy your outside shower, your double sunbed and each other. Dinner will be served on a table dug into the beach sand, with the water touching your feet and the endless stars above you.
blocks.html: When it comes to romantic escapes, Mnemba Island is THE place. A handful of private bandas on a tiny island make you feel like a Robinson Crusoe couple who got lucky: stranded, contented and thriving. Straight from your bed you can slip into the crystal-clear Indian Ocean and its magnificent coral reefs. Make the most of your outdoor shower, your double sunbed and each other. Dinner is served at a table set into the beach sand, with the sea lapping at your feet and endless stars overhead.

blocks.orig: This beautiful small island just south of Mafia Island is another perfect romantic getaway. Only reachable by a small plane and then a boat, this island offers ten beautifully designed beach villas with the utmost privacy. However luxuriously appointed the villas might be, this is where you live a relatively simple beach life, as your accommodation is directly located on the white sandy beach. From your bed, you can dive straight into the blue Indian Ocean and join tropical fish and turtles on their morning swim. After a relaxing day in paradise, you can enjoy a yummy dinner in an old, renovated lighthouse.
blocks.html: Just south of Mafia Island, this lovely little island is another ideal romantic hideaway. You can only get there by small plane followed by a boat, and it offers ten beautifully designed beach villas with complete privacy. Luxurious though the villas are, life here is a fairly simple beach existence, as your accommodation stands right on the white sand. Dive from your bed straight into the blue Indian Ocean and join the tropical fish and turtles for their morning swim. After a lazy day in paradise, a tasty dinner awaits in an old, restored lighthouse.
